summary: Backend-only verification of the fastapi upper-bound pin + /app/backend/server.py deployment shim (production ModuleNotFoundError: annotated_doc). New suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_pins_and_shim.py (51 tests) -> 51/51 passed. Full regression across all 6 suites -> 124/124 passed in 120s. MANIFESTS: both /app/requirements.txt and /app/backend/requirements.txt are byte-identical and declare all 15 required packages (fastapi>=0.110.0,<0.116; uvicorn[standard]>=0.28.0,<0.35; click>=8.1.0; starlette>=0.36.0,<0.42; pydantic>=2.6.0,<3.0; annotated-doc>=0.0.5; python-multipart; pillow; pytesseract; python-dotenv; httpx; bcrypt; motor; pymongo; emergentintegrations). Asserted programmatically with packaging.Requirement that the fastapi specifier ALLOWS 0.110.1 and REJECTS 0.141.0, uvicorn keeps the [standard] extra with <=0.35 bound, pydantic rejects 3.0.0. INSTALL PATH: `pip install --dry-run --report -` on the backend manifest -> rc=0, no ResolutionImpossible/conflict. Additionally ran a stricter fully-isolated resolve (`--ignore-installed --target /tmp/dryrun_target`) which resolved 86 packages with fastapi 0.115.14 (<0.116, i.e. pre-annotated_doc-break), annotated-doc 0.0.5, uvicorn 0.34.3, starlette 0.41.3, pydantic 2.13.4, click 8.4.2 — confirming the production image will get annotated-doc and will NOT jump to fastapi 0.141.x. SHIM: `from server import app` with cwd=/app/backend prints 'IngreLens API' (rc=0); `from app.main import app` with cwd=/app also prints 'IngreLens API'; verified `server.app is app.main.app` -> True (same singleton, not a duplicate FastAPI instance) and that the shim exposes /api routes; shim is <40 non-blank lines. Installed runtime fastapi 0.110.1 satisfies the manifest pin. No supervisor reconfiguration attempted, per instructions. LIVE REGRESSION (curl against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): GET /api/health -> 200 healthy; POST /api/auth/login with seeded QA account -> 200 + token; GET /api/profile -> avatar + allergies + age present (partial-PUT merge holds); GET /api/barcode/3017620422003?mode=FOOD -> Nutella via source=openfoodfacts; POST /api/scan with barcode only -> real Claude analysis (safety_score 4.0, 7 ingredients, 3 flagged, per-ingredient hazard reasoning referencing the user's low-sugar goal). AUTH PLAYBOOK: bcrypt hash for the seeded user starts with $2b$12$; brute-force lockout confirmed — 5x wrong password -> 401, 6th -> 429 'Too many attempts', and the CORRECT password is then also rejected with 429 (lockout is per-identifier, backed by a login_attempts collection). No httpOnly auth cookie is set on login — the app is intentionally bearer-token based (the only Set-Cookie is Cloudflare's __cf_bm), so the cookie/CSRF part of the playbook does not apply; there is no admin/seed_admin flow in this app.

minor.issue: Still unresolved from iterations 5-6: allow_origins defaults to ["*"] while allow_credentials=True. Verified live — OPTIONS /api/health with Origin: https://evil.example returns access-control-allow-origin: *. Browsers ignore credentialed requests with a wildcard origin, and it is an over-permissive default. Set CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit preview/production origins.

action_items: Optional hardening only: set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins instead of the "*" default (allow_credentials=True is incompatible with a wildcard origin).
Nothing blocking — the annotated_doc deploy fix is verified correct at both the manifest and entry-point level; production redeploy can proceed.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/requirements.txt and /app/backend/requirements.txt are byte-identical duplicates and must be edited in lockstep; drift here is exactly what caused the earlier click/annotated_doc failures. Consider making the root file `-r backend/requirements.txt` once you confirm the deployer supports include directives.

emergentintegrations>=0.2.0 is the only dependency with no upper bound and it transitively pulls fastapi-adjacent packages; a future major there could re-trigger the same resolution drift. Consider bounding it too.

The shim relies on sys.path.insert of the parent dir; if the deployer ever copies only /app/backend into the image, `from app.main import app` will fail with ModuleNotFoundError: app. Worth a defensive, explicit error message in server.py so the failure mode is obvious in deploy logs.

Also note the upstream OpenFoodFacts record for barcode 3017620422003 currently has crowd-edited ingredients_text ('CURL_ING_OVERRIDE_...'), which is external data pollution, not an app bug — avoid asserting exact ingredient strings for that barcode. Only open item is the CORS wildcard + allow_credentials nit.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the production failure: /app/backend/requirements.txt specified `fastapi>=0.110.0` with no upper bound, so the deployer's fresh pip resolve picked fastapi 0.141.x, which imports the newly split-out `annotated_doc` package at import time; that package was not in the manifest, so the container crash-looped with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'annotated_doc'. Secondary risk: the deployer expects `server:app` at /app/backend/server.py while this Vite-rooted project only had app/main.py. Both fixes verified: an isolated pip resolve of the pinned manifest now yields fastapi 0.115.14 plus annotated-doc 0.0.5, and both `server:app` (cwd=/app/backend) and `app.main:app` (cwd=/app) import successfully and are literally the same FastAPI instance titled 'IngreLens API'. 124/124 regression tests and all live endpoint checks pass on the pinned versions.
